name: Mad Labs Disposable | Watermelon Z
description: An indica-dominant strain celebrated for its fruity profile and calming effects, offering a mellow euphoric lift that settles into soothing full-body relaxation—ideal for unwinding without heavy sedation. On the exhale, Watermelon Z hits with juicy watermelon and candy-sweet fruit, layered with subtle berry notes and a smooth, refreshing finish.
